_notes: Hades slice prop layout (data layer replacement for BuildSliceProps.AddProps and BuildSliceSmoke.AddBoulders). Coordinates are Unity world metres, y up, z toward the gate. pos y = constants[yBase] + pos[1] (yBase 'world' = 0). ground 'bottom': LOD0 bounds bottom sits on pos y (PlaceLod behaviour). ground 'boundsCentreSink': LOD0 bounds centre goes on pos xz, then the bottom is sunk to waterY - sinkFraction * height (old AddBoulders). Seeded jitter (boulders seed 31, trees seed 77) is baked as numbers; edit the numbers freely. Entries with tag 'new' come from UNITY_MISSING_PROPS.md and are disabled until approved. disabled=true skips an entry. baseColorMul tints base colour (old broken_oar hack). Entries tagged 'hero' (r4) use GLBs from hades_env/processed/hero_props/<name>/ that must be copied to Assets/Env/Props/<name>/; they do not need a Prop-schema change (no alignToGround support in the loader: positions are not terrain-snapped); 'rationale' is a free text field ignored by the loader (JsonUtility skips unknown fields). hero_heavy LOD profile = aggressive switching for >50k tri props. asset file = libraries[library].pattern with {asset} and {lod}. | v2 (world build): WorldNear/WorldMid/WorldFar groups from scripts/world_layout_gen.py; pos y already snapped to terrain_midground (ground bottom).
